newsitem.title: USA: Jostens buys unit from Town & Country.
newsitem.headline: Jostens buys unit from Town & Country.

text.p: Jostens Inc said Monday it purchased the Gold Lance retail class ring business from Town & Country Corp for about $11 million in cash.
Gold Lance had sales of about $13 million in the 12 months ended in February, it added.
Jostens said the acquisition of Gold Lance provides it with a competitive presence in the retail class ring business, complementing its business that sells class rings through high schools.
The Gold Lance transaction will be recorded in the second quarter, Jostens said.

"The acquisition of Gold Lance builds upon our strategy to expand from our healthy in-school businesses into new markets and new distribution channels for Jostens' current and future products," Robert Buhrmaster, president, said in a statement. "Gold Lance provides us with a recognized brand, an installed base of accounts and a competitive retail presence to complement our leading in-school position."
He added Jostens hops to use the retail channel not only for class rings, but other products as well.

Jostens said it acquired the accounts, related information and the brand of Gold Lance, whose products are sold at about 5,000 retail locations nationwide, including Zales and Gordon's jewelry stores. Jostens, which currently offers products at retail through its Studio 1 brand, said it will market products under the Gold Lance and Studio 1 names.
Jostens said it expects to offer positions to selected Gold Lance sales and marketing personnel. Other employees and the Gold Lance manufacturing plant in Houston will remain with Town & Country.
